text: In April 2025, the Lukashenko regime added Stephen Chbosky's The Perks of Being a Wallflower to its list of printed publications containing information messages and materials, the distribution of which could harm the national interests of Belarus. In 2025, Utah banned the book from all public schools in the state.
meta_description: The Perks of Being a Wallflower by Stephen Chbosky: banned from all public schools in Utah in 2025; added to a Belarus list of harmful publications in April 2025.
changes: Order: the April 2025 Belarus event placed before the undated 2025 Utah ban; wording from the source quotes.
